title: Glimmering Forest

outfit_card.silhouette: A-line pinafore-style dress over a sheer high-neck blouse, featuring voluminous dual-layer sleeves and a flared knee-length skirt with soft ruffled tiers.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An oversized sculptural mushroom cap hat with ruffled underbrim, topped with a miniature mushroom cluster and accented by a dark ribbon bow.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sheer organza high-neck blouse with lace trim and ribbon ties at the collar, layered under a fitted terracotta pinafore bodice with decorative buttons and full puff sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered knee-length skirt in rust and cream with scalloped lace edging, petticoat ruffles, and a front apron panel, paired with lace-trimmed stockings and ankle boots.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating glowing spore motes, miniature mushroom companions, and a woven basket or set accessory evoking a woodland forage.
